free_desc: Completely free. Cleans most web content, works without logging in, no forced subscriptions. Register and log in to instantly activate a 30-day Pro experience. If it meets your daily needs, you can use it forever for free.

fam_desc: Protect your whole family's digital security. Supports up to 9 devices simultaneously.
tooltip_desc: Browser A and Browser B on the same PC count as 2 devices. Android A + PC Browser A count as 2 devices. If you exceed the limit, you can unbind old devices with one click in the dashboard.
tooltip_desc_family: Supports up to 9 devices simultaneously. The main account can send invite links to family members from the dashboard. Once they log in and accept, they join the family group and share the device quota. You can unbind devices or remove members anytime.
